name: @miorin/dsh-atlas-list
description: Switch sidebar list views, mark drafts, keep watched sessions visible, see active jobs, and check collapsed sidebar session counts.

scripts.prepare: node --input-type=module -e "import { existsSync } from 'node:fs'; import { execFileSync } from 'node:child_process'; const cli = '../../tools/dsh-aggregate/src/cli.mts'; if (existsSync(cli)) execFileSync(process.execPath, [cli, 'generate', '.'], { stdio: 'inherit' })" 1>&2
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run check
scripts.check: node --input-type=module -e "import { existsSync, readFileSync } from 'node:fs'; import { execFileSync } from 'node:child_process'; const cli = '../../tools/dsh-aggregate/src/cli.mts'; if (existsSync(cli)) { execFileSync(process.execPath, [cli, 'check', '.'], { stdio: 'inherit' }); } else { for (const f of ['index.js', 'client.js', 'cordis.patch.yml', 'aggregate.yml', 'package.json']) { if (!existsSync(f)) throw new Error('missing ' + f); } JSON.parse(readFileSync('package.json', 'utf8')); }"
scripts.prepublishOnly: node --input-type=module -e "import { existsSync, readFileSync } from 'node:fs'; import { execFileSync } from 'node:child_process'; const cli = '../../tools/dsh-aggregate/src/cli.mts'; if (existsSync(cli)) { execFileSync(process.execPath, [cli, 'verify-release', '.'], { stdio: 'inherit' }); } else { for (const f of ['index.js', 'client.js', 'cordis.patch.yml', 'aggregate.yml', 'package.json']) { if (!existsSync(f)) throw new Error('missing ' + f); } const pkg = JSON.parse(readFileSync('package.json', 'utf8')); if (pkg.private === true) throw new Error('package.json has private: true'); for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(pkg.dependencies ?? {})) { if (typeof v === 'string' && (v.startsWith('link:') || v.startsWith('file:'))) throw new Error('unpinned dependency ' + k + '=' + v); } if (/^\s+spec:\s*(?:link:|file:)/m.test(readFileSync('aggregate.yml', 'utf8'))) throw new Error('unpinned spec in aggregate.yml'); }"
